messages:
alex: FYI proposal to pivot telemetry schema. Idea is to extract route metadata out of the event envelope into a dedicated route_info table and store only route_id on events. Reason: massive space savings, faster per-route queries, and simpler quota joins.

jia: Sounds promising. What's the compatibility/backfill plan? We can't break dashboards or quota checks.

alex: Plan (high level):
1) Read adapter: create a view events_v2 that reconstructs route_id by joining route_info when present.
2) Dual write: adapt ingest to write route_info + route_id while still keeping old envelope fields for a grace period.
3) Backfill: tenant-sharded backfill job to populate route_info from historical envelopes.
4) Cutover: switch console/api to events_v2 and remove envelope after ~30d of stable traffic.

jia: Can you show the view SQL so we can assess perf?

alex: Sure, prototype view:```
CREATE VIEW console.events_v2 AS
SELECT e.id, e.ts, e.payload, COALESCE(r.route_id, e.envelope->>'route_id') AS route_id
FROM console.events e
LEFT JOIN console.route_info r ON r.envelope_hash = md5(e.envelope::text);
```

jia: Concern: md5 join on envelope text is going to be slow and expensive. Suggest we add route_hash at ingest time and index that column, then backfill route_hash for old rows.

alex: Agreed. We'll add route_hash column + index. Backfill job will compute route_hash when scanning. Backfill strategy: tenant-sharded, windowed (24h slices), parallelism ~100, low-IO priority. Example k8s job command:```
kubectl run backfill-routeinfo --image=redwood/mig-tool:prod -- /usr/local/bin/backfill --start 2026-03-01 --end 2026-03-02 --shard 42
```

sam: Dashboards/alerts note: saved queries in Grafana/Metabase might reference envelope->route fields. We should provide compatibility views: events_v1 (old shape) and events_v2, and add redirect views so saved dashboards keep working. Also update cost dashboards that group by route_id.

marie: From product/console side: for rollouts we need a per-tenant preview toggle and an opt-in flag for teams to test v2 behavior. Also display migration status on routes page so SREs know which tenants are on v2.

devx: SDK/API change: add an opt-in header 'Telemetry-Schema: v2' clients can send if they want new behavior earlier. Also announce in changelog and add migration notes to quickstarts.

eng-platform-bot: Scheduling dark-write (dual write) run for next Tue 03:00 UTC across ingest fleet. Will create canary subset and emit metrics.

devx: Quotas: if route metadata is moved out, quota lookups become a join at charge time. Suggest we maintain a materialized route cache (route_id->quota_bucket) with TTL and pubsub invalidation on route updates. That keeps hot-path cheap.

alex: Yup — materialized cache + pubsub invalidation makes sense. We'll implement local in-memory cache with fallback to DB.

jia: Backfill IO risk: we need rate limiting and a low-priority queue (nice) to avoid impacting P99. Also add p95/p99 watchers and abort thresholds.

sam: I'll draft a runbook: backfill windows, abort conditions, how to throttle, rollback steps, monitoring queries to run.

marie: Can someone author a short RFC? I can schedule a 30m sync Wed to go over the plan and decisions.

alex: I'll write the RFC and include migration timelines, metrics to watch, and rollout gating criteria.

devx: lgtm.

jia: +1

eng-platform-bot: Ticket created: INF-1234 "telemetry schema pivot: route_info extract/backfill" assigned to alex.

alex: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
